## 1. Start with the Inspection Records

Before you begin documentation, review the relevant inspection records. These records will serve as the foundation for your detailed report.

*   **Original Inspection Report:** This provides the initial overview of the accessibility checks performed and any initial findings.
*   **Checklist:** Refer to the checklist used during the inspection to ensure all required areas were reviewed.
*   **Previous Reports:** If this isn't the first accessibility check for the building, review any previous reports to understand if issues have been identified before and if any remediation efforts were made.

## 2. What are the Accessibility Requirements?

Referencing the relevant accessibility standards is critical. These standards provide the specific guidelines against which the building is being evaluated.
